categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the electronic special gases and fluorine-containing new materials sectors. Its main products include high-purity trifluoride nitrogen, tungsten hexafluoride, hydrogen chloride, hydrogen fluoride, silicon tetrafluoride, deuterium gas, hexafluorobutadiene, octafluorocyclobutane, electronic mixed gases, and trifluoromethanesulfonic acid series products. These products serve industries such as integrated circuits, display panels, lithium-ion new energy, pharmaceuticals, and optical fibers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies including electrochemical fluorination, chemical synthesis, distillation, chemical purification, adsorption, gas mixing, trace impurity analysis, filling technology, and green environmental protection. It has developed proprietary international-leading technologies in electrochemical fluorination and chemical synthesis, enabling high-purity gas production and stable quality. The production process involves synthesis, purification, analysis, and filling, with strict quality and safety controls.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading integrated circuit manufacturers such as TSMC, Micron, SK Hynix, SMIC, Yangtze Memory, and display panel companies like BOE and TCL Technology. The company also serves pharmaceutical giants like Johnson & Johnson, Merck, and BASF, as well as new energy battery material companies. The products are critical materials for semiconductor, display, lithium battery, pharmaceutical, and optical fiber industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Handan (Hebei Province) and service centers in Shanghai, Chongqing, Hefei, and Shenzhen. It has established a subsidiary in Shanghai to leverage regional advantages and plans to expand overseas with regional service centers and local filling plants in countries including South Korea and Japan. Its products are sold domestically and exported to Europe, North America, Japan, and South Korea.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of high-purity electronic special gases and fluorine-containing materials. It procures raw materials and auxiliary materials, synthesizes and purifies gases, and supplies finished products directly to downstream semiconductor and display manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding product varieties to cover 70-80 types within three years, solving capacity layout issues within five years, and deeply integrating with semiconductor manufacturing processes over 8-10 years. The company emphasizes innovation in electrochemical fluorination, chemical synthesis, purification, trace impurity analysis, and filling technologies. It invests heavily in R&D, focusing on advanced process compatibility, new low-GWP etching gases, and metal-based precursors, while building national and provincial innovation platforms.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of electronic special gases and fluorine-containing new materials to downstream customers in integrated circuits, display panels, pharmaceuticals, and new energy sectors. The company adopts an order-driven production model with direct sales as the main channel, supplemented by limited sales through distributors. Pricing is negotiated individually with customers based on product type, cost, and cooperation plans.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a domestic leader in electronic special gases with the largest production capacity in China and ranks among the top globally. Major international competitors include Linde, Air Liquide, Taiyo Nippon Sanso, and Air Products. Domestic competitors include Nanda Optoelectronics and Haohua Technology. The company holds a strong position in niche segments with advanced technology and is recognized as a key player in the national semiconductor materials supply chain.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.62 billion, a 17.39% decrease from the previous year, mainly due to a downturn in the semiconductor and display industries. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 335 million, down 12.55%. Total assets reached RMB 5.84 billion, and net assets attributable to shareholders were RMB 5.31 billion, reflecting significant growth due to the IPO proceeds. R&D investment increased to nearly RMB 161 million, accounting for 9.94% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its advanced proprietary technologies, high product purity, and stable quality, which are critical for high-end semiconductor manufacturing processes. It offers a broad product portfolio with over 70 mature products and strong R&D capabilities, enabling domestic substitution of imported products. The company provides comprehensive service networks and localized support, ensuring supply chain security and customer trust. Its products meet stringent purity and stability requirements for advanced semiconductor nodes, supporting customers' yield and performance.
